newsitem.title: USA: Clinton's personnel chief leaving to take Trinity job.
newsitem.headline: Clinton's personnel chief leaving to take Trinity job.

text.p: The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) said Tuesday its director, James King, would leave his job by Labour Day to take a senior position at Trinity College in Hartford, Connecticut.
King, who has served as OPM director since April 1993, headed the National Transportation Safety Board under former President Jimmy Carter.
A native of Ludlow, Mass., King also held senior positions on the staffs of Sen. John Kerrey and Sen. Edward Kennedy, both Democrats from Massachusetts.
Deputy OPM Director Janice Lachance will assume King's responsibilities until President Clinton nominated someone to fill the post.
